biggest_catch: The bonus is paid at the time the new account opens, which is fast - but the friend must open as the primary owner, fund $100, and your own checking/savings/money-market account must be open with a positive balance or you get nothing.
catches: Referrer must be an existing CIBM Bank customer with a checking, savings, or money market account open and with a positive balance at payout.
Friend must open a NEW CIBM Bank checking account as the primary owner; existing customers and anyone who closed an account in the past 6 months are ineligible.
Referral form must be presented in branch or referral source entered online at account opening; minimum $100 opening deposit required.
Bonus paid at the time of new account opening to both parties' accounts.
If the friend closes the account within 6 months, a $25 early closing fee applies.
Bonus reportable as interest/income on IRS Form 1099-INT/MISC; employees ineligible.
Offer expires 12/31/2026; subject to amendment/cancellation at any time.
Unlimited referral bonuses for referring customers.

steps: Complete the CIBM Bank Refer-A-Friend form and give it to your friend.
Friend opens a new CIBM Bank checking account as the primary owner with a $100 minimum deposit, presenting the form (or entering the referral source online).
A $50 bonus is paid to your account at the time of the new account opening - repeat unlimited times.
timing: $50 paid to both parties' accounts at the time of new account opening; your account must be open with a positive balance.
when_cash_arrives: $50 paid to both parties' accounts at the time the new account opens - no processing window at all. The friend opens online as primary owner and funds $100.
maximize: Payout fires at account opening - have the friend complete the online application and the $100 funding in one sitting.
Keep your own CIBM checking/savings/money-market account open with a positive balance or you forfeit the bonus.
The friend must open as the primary owner.
